header.title: For My Beloved, Adored, and Plushy-like Munchkin,
header.subtitle: I don't care how many obstacles come in the way. If you're willing, we'll beat 'em all.

introLetter:
To Ishika, 

I started working on this around 17th July. I had a dream about us and our future. What we were like, where we were living, and all the works. The exact snippet of our future I saw was us sitting on our porch in the rain. I got us the wine, while you played a mixtape I made for you. And I haven't been able to stop thinking about it since then. And I haven't stopped thinking about you and us since then. It feels as if there were magnets in my bones for the iron in your blood. 

One day we'll make that dream a reality, but till then let this "mixtape" keep you company. 

Yours Truly, 

 "Chumkins"

songs.title: Sunshine & Butterflies - lilypichu
songs.letter:
it all started when we first matched. all those nights of talking on Instagram. getting to know that we found each other in a very Chinese time of our life. getting to know we share a lot of the same opinions and stances. figuring out you're not a call person. still talking to you on call for 6 hours the first time. realizing this will be hell cause i am in love with your voice. and finally realizing i would put up with anything and everything if it meant being close to you. 

then it was the excitement of when college ended. every step was a step closer to you. packing my bag, all i could think was "will she like this shirt?" the flight home, the constant texting, the pure unbridled excitement in the air. i reached home. there were literally less than 12 hours before i finally met you. but it felt like an eternity. it was too much still. from sneaking out with my sister's help, to pushing the bike all the way outside the building compound, all the way to the point i was outside the campus gate waiting for you. 

you were everything i had hoped to find in a person. you were what i had been looking for in each person before you. and i hope you're all i look forward to from now on.

songs.title: Her - JVKE
songs.letter:
i remember the exact moment I met you. it was at 4:22am on 16th May. suddenly i stopped judging all the shitty romcoms I'd ever seen. suddenly all the songs about that "realization" on the first meet started making sense. you were the most ethereal being there ever was, and ever will be. you were it. you were the moment. that first hug happened, and i could understand why people fall for religious propaganda willingly. but you were religion perfected. 

you were exactly how you were online. your bubbly personality. your witty humor. your adorable gremlin like behavior. and your eyes. oh your eyes. i could stare into your eyes for eternity. the way you couldn't stand still while talking, and the immense excitement you had retelling me stories. it was infectious. and that was the moment i knew.
